reply.text:
Sorry to hear the gym buddy situation has gotten strained. That's a rough thing to train around, and it's fair to want some space to lift on your own terms.

I can build you a solo program. Tell me what you're after: is the goal strength on the main lifts, building size, or just a steady schedule you can run without a partner spotting or pushing you? Also tell me how many days a week you can get in and what equipment you have, and I'll put it together in the app.
